Cisco Cloud Control with AgenticOps
Cisco Cloud Control with AgenticOps serves as the autonomous control
plane for hybrid cloud environments. By integrating "AgenticOps"—a
framework of specialized, task-oriented AI agents—the system moves
beyond traditional automation into autonomous remediation and lifecycle
management. It is designed to handle complex compliance requirements by
enabling agents to autonomously detect drift, perform vulnerability
remediation, and ensure that infrastructure state remains continuously
aligned with defined security policies.
Cisco Cloud Control is the unified management and orchestration platform
for hybrid and multi-cloud environments. It acts as the central plane for
governing, securing, and operating distributed infrastructure, providing
consistent policy enforcement and lifecycle automation across disparate
cloud services and data centers. By centralizing management, it eliminates
operational silos, streamlines compliance, and ensures that infrastructure
remains performant and secure at scale.
The Rich Suite of Offers
To support the autonomous capabilities of Cloud Control, the following
products integrate into a cohesive operational ecosystem:
1. AI Canvas
● Description: The design and orchestration workbench for the
AgenticOps ecosystem. AI Canvas provides a visual interface for
engineering teams to design, model, and deploy autonomous agents.
It allows for the mapping of complex operational workflows into
executable logic, ensuring that agents are constrained by well-defined
operational boundaries before they are deployed to manage
production environments.
2. AI Assistant
● Description: The natural language operational interface for the suite.
AI Assistant bridges the gap between human intent and machine
execution. It enables engineers to query system status, request
complex remediation tasks, or gain insights into compliance posture
through conversational interactions. It serves as the primary gateway
for users to interface with the autonomous agents created in AI
Canvas.
3. Cisco IQ
● Description: The centralized intelligence and observability engine.
Cisco IQ processes massive streams of telemetry data from across the
cloud infrastructure to provide actionable insights. It serves as the
"brain" for the agents, providing the contextual data required for
informed decision-making, trend analysis, and predictive modeling,
ensuring that operational actions are grounded in current, real-time
data.
4. AI Defense
● Description: The dedicated security layer for the AI model pipeline
and agentic infrastructure. AI Defense provides the necessary
guardrails to protect AI models from adversarial manipulation, data
leakage, and unauthorized access. In high-compliance environments,
it ensures that the models driving the agents are hardened, verifiable,
and protected against vulnerabilities that could compromise the
integrity of the automated security remediation processes.

Details Analysis/ Evidence of Automation (KSI Focus)
The FedRAMP 20x rules heavily emphasize Persistent and Automated activities.
• Strengths: AI Defense SOC 2 report confirms the use of Datadog for
availability monitoring (CCF-STA-03.02) and Jenkins/ArgoCD for automated
CI/CD pipeline validation (CCF-CCC-04.02).
• FedRAMP 20x Class A requires the JSON schema output for these
activities. AI Defense SOC 2 proves the existence of the control; AI Defense
will ensure these tools output to the specific FedRAMP JSON schema
.
required by FRC-CSO-JSN
Penetration Testing Requirements
• Rule: FRC-CLA-MFR mandates annual penetration testing (CCF-TVM-
02.02 in your SOC 2).
• AI Defense SOC 2 report confirms annual pen testing was performed.
Data Flow and Scope
• Rule: MAS-CSO-IIR requires a machine-readable inventory of all information
resources.
• AI Defense have CCF-DSP-01.02 (Inventory maintenance) and CCF-DSP-
02.02 (Data flow documentation). Since these already exist in Defense SOC 2
description, the LOE for this requirement is primarily formatting (mapping current
inventory artifacts into the FedRAMP JSON/OSCAL structure) which is done at
time of submission to FedRAMP.
Additional Notes on Implementations
• JSON Schema Mapping (FRC-CSO-JSN & CDS-CSO-PUB): Defense SOC 2
report contains rich control evidence. The biggest lift for Class A is moving
from documentary evidence (PDFs) to structured data (JSON/OSCAL). Defense
Compliance team will export existing audit logs from Splunk and AWS CloudTrail
directly into the FedRAMP JSON schema format defined in the ruleset.
• Addressing "New" Requirements: Rules like AFC-CSO-INB (Security Inbox)
and CDS-CSO-UTC (Trust Center) are not typically found in SOC 2 reports.
These are operational requirements. Since Cisco AI Defense already has an
established Incident Response and Communication procedure (CCF-SEF-01.01),
AI Defense leverages existing communication protocols and use
the fedramp_security@cisco.com alias to satisfy this rule.
• Refining "Persistent" Indicators: Several rules require "persistent" verification
(e.g., KSI-CNA-MAT, KSI-CNA-RNT). AI Defense’s SOC 2 audit tested these on
an annual or quarterly basis. To satisfy 20x, cadence is persistently (e.g.,
automated weekly check) and ensure Datadog or AWS Security Hub configuration
snapshots document this frequency.
Agency Use Case: MKT-IIP-AGU. SOC 2 confirms the AI Defense System is
designed to identify and manage AI model risks across distributed environments. This
is AI Defense’s "Direct Use" case justification for the FedRAMP marketplace listing.

certifiedServices.serviceDescription:
Security Cloud Control is Cisco’s unified, cloud-native security management
interface for the Cisco Security Cloud. It simplifies and strengthens
defenses by centralizing security solutions into a single, cohesive interface.
This approach eliminates silos, reduces complexity, and provides end-to-
end visibility, empowering organizations to proactively address security

Cisco AI Defense is a comprehensive AI security solution designed to
secure AI models, applications, and agents throughout their lifecycle. It
provides continuous discovery of AI assets such as models, agents, and
datasets across cloud environments including AWS. The service detects
vulnerabilities through automated model validation, supply chain scanning,
and algorithmic red teaming. It protects AI workloads at runtime with
guardrails that block harmful inputs and outputs, preventing threats like
prompt injection, data leakage, and unsafe agent behavior.

AI Canvas is a shared operational workspace where people and AI agents
work together to investigate and resolve IT issues.
An investigation in AI Canvas can bring together information from Cisco
products and integrated third-party systems—such as monitoring, incident-
management, security, automation, and knowledge-management tools—
along with uploaded files, organizational knowledge, and specialized AI
agents.

Cisco IQ is a suite of AI-powered applications designed to enhance the
customer experience by delivering real-time insights, assessments,
troubleshooting, learning, automation, and agent-driven guidance
throughout the entire customer lifecycle. It connects the entire customer
journey with Cisco Services, helping customers plan, deploy, manage,
secure, and optimize their IT environments. Cisco IQ provides a unified,
interactive digital experience available via SaaS, with upcoming On-
Premises and API deployment options.

Cisco AI Assistant is an intelligent, conversational AI tool integrated into
Cisco network management platforms such as the Meraki dashboard and
Cisco Catalyst Center. It enables IT teams to expedite routine tasks, gain
real-time network insights, and optimize network performance using natural
language prompts. The assistant leverages Cisco’s Deep Network Model
and global expertise to provide context-aware insights, automate routine
workflows, and accelerate troubleshooting with step-by-step guidance and
documentation summaries. It helps simplify network management by
delivering real-time health information, identifying root causes of issues,
and enabling automated configuration changes through conversational
commands. Cisco AI Assistant is designed to reduce manual errors,
increase efficiency, and empower IT teams to operate with greater
confidence and productivity across their networks
